entries.title: Spacebase Startopia

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Spacebase Startopia is a Realmforge/Kalypso space-station management strategy game released on Steam in March 2021. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS, with single-player and online PvP features. No platform-exclusive gameplay content was found for console routes in this pass, so Windows PC is the preferred archive path for capture/settings control and desktop interface fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for the main archive route. Use macOS/Linux as native desktop alternatives and console versions only for couch/platform comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a modern successor/reimagining of Startopia, not a remaster that replaces the original 2001 Startopia entry.
